tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i phreng ba

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bde ba'i rang bzhin a yig las 'ongs thabs kyi mchog gyur pha rgyud dang*// stong gsal 'gag med haṃ yig las 'ongs shes rab ngo bo ma rgyud de/ bde stong a haṃ thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen 'khor lo'i ye shes ni// pha rgyud ma rgyud sdom pa'i snying rje gnyis med dgyes rdor la phyag 'tshal// gang zhig 'og min zhing du sangs rgyas kyang*// slar yang gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing khams 'dir// 'gro don mdzad la chog shes mi mnga' ba/ */brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ */mkhas dang grub pa'i dpal mnga' zhing*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khur lci ba// 'degs byed spos kyi glang po che// byams pa'i mtshan can rgyal gyur cig /gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho chen po yi| |snying po nor bu dgyes pa rdo rje 'di// lan cig nyams su blang bar 'dod rnams kyi// chog gzhung gru gzings bzang po 'dir zhugs te// ngal ba med par 'dong phyir 'di bri'o// 'dir dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa po'i yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor dang*/ bum pa sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyer bsdogs byas la/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur pa'i ngang nas/ bdud rtsi/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa me rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a dkar po las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus su na las mi'i sha| shar du go las ba lang gi sha/

lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bhrūṃ las dri chen dang me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las rakta dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzrīṃ las byang sems dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de'i steng du kha chod kyi tshul du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ nas/ aṃ ā ཿ dang*/ g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ nas| sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje'i rtse gsum dang*/ rdo rje dbyangs gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gong ltar byin rlabs byas la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu| ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*| |'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*| |longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol| |dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces gtor ma phul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rang bzhin stong pa zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= puṣpaṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gandhaṃ= nai wi dyaṃ= shapad zhes sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur| bla bre/ mda' yi dra ba/ phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bhrūṃ las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtsibs so so'i nang du pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid bhrūṃ las gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sku mdog ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/

shar du gshin rje mthar byed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ dkar sngon po rdor dril 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang khro zhing gtum pa/ sku sbom zhing gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs dor stabs su bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna la ser sna rdo rje/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo rnams su gsal ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ bgegs thams cad dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su bskrad cing ma song ba rnams kyang thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhrūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nas/ bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces srung 'khor bsgom/ rang nyid skad cig gis kye rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs par mos te/ mchod pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod mi ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas| |g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas thob par shog / ces gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig |sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / ces gsum brjod/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yongs su gyur pa las| e las chos kyi 'byung gnas sngon po gru gsum pa rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ de'i steng du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu'i ba dan la yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhrūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa nang nas rim bzhin du/ nag /ljang*/ dmar/ ser/ sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu ser po dang*/ dra ba dang*/ dra phyed 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du ba ku li dang*/ rin po che'i mda' yab pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje'i me tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po de'i phyi rol du sna tshogs padma dang rdo rje'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga dang ldan pa rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du chu brgyad kyis phye ba'i dur khrod brgyad de/ gtum drag /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ rdo rje 'bar ba/ keng rus can/ mi bzad bzhed pa/ bkra shis tshal/ mun pa drag po/ kī li kī la sgrog pa de rnams su shing chen po brgyad de/ shirṣa/ tsūtta/ kaṅka la/ a shwattha/ dhu pa ṭa/ ka rañdza/ 'khri shing can/ ardzu na/

de rnams kyi rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ dbang po brgya byin ser po/ chu lha dkar po/ gshin rje sngon po/ dbang phyug dkar po/ me lha dmar po/ srin po sngon po/ rlung lha dud kha rnams dang*/ shing gi rtse mor zhing skyong brgyad de/ glang po che dang*/ mi dang*/ chu srin dang*/ ma he dang*/ glang dang*/ ra dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha ba'i gdong can dang*/ chu la gnas pa'i klu brgyad ni/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ dung skyong*/ padma/ padma chen po/ mtha' yas/ rigs ldan dang*/ de dag gi steng du/ sprin chen po brgyad ni/ sgrog pa/ cher sgrog pa/ drag po/ g.yo ba/ brtan pa/ gang ba/ 'bebs pa/ gtum po rnams dang*/ ri brgyad ni/ lhun po/ mandha ra/ kai la sha/ mā la ya/ dbang chen/ spos ngad ldan/ gangs can/ dpal gyi ri bo rnams so// mchod rten brgyad ni/ rdo rje/ rdo rje 'dus byas/ rdo rje phyag pa/ rdo rje nag po/ thugs rdo rje/ sku rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje rnams dang*/ gzhan yang keṃ rus dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ bya khyi gcan gzan la sogs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha rnams gan rkyal du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtshan bzang po sum cu'i ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ nas/ aṃ āḥ sogs/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor dkar po me long lta bu'i ye shes/

de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ nas/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ sogs/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ de'i g.yon du aṃ aḥlas gri gug sngo nag yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// dbus kyi gdan la hūm̐ dang rdo rje las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs| chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje sku sngo sangs zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag po/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du bcings pa la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po bzung ba'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka /drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/

brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po rnams/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan la rin po che'i rtse bran gyis spras pa/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon bskum pa'i sor mo rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba 'jigs su rung*// rgod cing drag shul rngam pa dang*// snying rje zhi ba'i ngo mtshar che// gar gyi nyams dgu ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po phyed bcings kyis rgyab tu grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan gcig tu brkyang zhing g.yas yab kyi sked la 'khril ba/ chags pa chen po'i nyams dang ldan pa gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' gsang mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte bar āḥyig gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang ba'i ngo bo mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ rdo rje zhe sdang chen po ni// dga' ba bzhi ni ster bar byed// mkha' 'gro'i gdong pa ro gcig mgon// bya bar mdzod cig bdag la'o// padma bde bar 'dzin pa ni// 'dod chags chen pos bde ba ster// dga' bzhi'i skal pa sna tshogs pa// bya bar mdzod cig bdag la'o// zhes pa'i sgras bskul te/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra gsang ba'i gnas su bsgrags pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le brgyad du gyur cing*/

de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ zhes pa'i sa bon rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur te/ mkha' nang gau rī dpag tu med pa 'phros| sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar du tshangs pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi tsau rī dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lhor dbang po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ tsau rī ma dmar po g.yas cang te'u dang*/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi be tā lī dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub tu nye dbang gi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ be tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi ghasma rī dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang du drag po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi pukka si' dpag tu med pa 'phros| sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang shar du gshin rje'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge dang*/ g.yon rdo rje'i dgra sta 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi ri khrod ma dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar lhor nor bdag gi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong dang*/ g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi gdol pa mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod/

tshur 'dus lho nub tu srin po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi g.yung mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub byang du thags bzang ris kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa gcer bu rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i khrod na bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ mig tu baṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo// rna bar daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon po/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying khar naṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo// spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma sku mdog dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang rus pas brgyan cing mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod la/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin rnams kyi sku// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur mdzod// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang*| pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha wa rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ be tā lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bhi nī la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur/ ces brjod/ arghaṃ sogs chu bzhi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ hā sya/ lā sya/ gī ti/ nṛ tyai/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ rnams dang*/ oṃ rū pa badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rū pa'i gnas su ra sa/ sparshe/ dharma dhā tu/ zhes sogs rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod/ nang mchod bdud rtsi mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// nag po pa dang ḍā ma ru pa dang*// a wa dhū ti ga ya dha ra dang*// 'brog mi lo tsā se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar kun dga' snying po'i mtshan// bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' rgyal mtshan chos rgyal 'phags pa dang*// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal| |bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// buddha shrī kun dga' bzang po dang*// shākya mchog ldan gzhon nu mchog grub dang*// kun dga' sgrol mchog kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*// byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho la sogs pa// dgyes pa rdo rje'i sprul pa'i lha dgu'i tshogs// chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐//

zhes mchod la| bstod pa ni/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun| |rdo rje can gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod// ces bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas thon lha mo brgyad kyi zhal du zhugs/ padma nas thon khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyai'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang gi thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ laṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor gyi snying po'o// de ltar gtso 'khor gyi bzlas pa ci rigs par byas la/ thun bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ gzhal yas khang lha mo brgyad la thim/ lha mo brgyad yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ slar yang rang nyid dgyes pa rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can| |gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// gang gi lam 'dir grol 'gyur ba// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog / ces smon lam gdab bo// de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// de nas bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas/

bum rdzas dang ldan pa chus sum gnyis bkang ba/ gtso bo rnam rgyal bum pa la bum mtshan thod pa rdo rje'i mtshan ma bris pa'i steng du/ dung chos dri chus bkang ba dang gzung thag btags pa'i rdo rje'ang bzhag /las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'i bum mtshan dang ldan pa/ gzhan yang mchod pa sogs brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ chu 'phyangs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul bcings shing*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ bcud bzang po rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud bzhi'i ngo bo zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong ltar ro// las bum gyi dbus pad nyi'i gdan la/ slar yang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can| zhabs dor stabs su ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dbang skur zhing don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod la/ sngar ltar mchod pa byin brlabs la/ chu bzhi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di| |bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mchod yon gyi gnas su / zhabs bsil/

'thor 'thung*/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan zhes bsgyur zhing*/ arghaṃ gyi mal du/ pā dyaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad/ zhes mchod cing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa yi// pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga rnga chen ma// sngon mo ser mo dmar mo ljang gu rnams// dang po'i phyag gnyis rang rtags phyag mtshan bsnams// de lhag mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// bzhad ma sgeg ma glu ma gar ma rnams// dmar skya sngon mo ser mo ljang gu ste// dang po'i phyag gnyis rang rang rtags mtshan ldan// g.yon mtha' thod pa kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab dang*// dkar mo mthing dmar dmar ser dmar mo rnams// g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭwāṃ g.yas dang po// rang min rjes mthun gnyis pa cang te'u// gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos ma rnams// dkar mo dmar mo ljang gu dkar mo ste// g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭwāṃ g.yas dang po// rang min rjes mthun gnyis pa cang te'u// kun bzang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la sgeg /lang tsho gzhon pas rol zhing 'gying bag can// rin chen rgyan ldan rab kyis rab tu mdzes// dpag med rab bsngags brjod cing mgon sogs mchod// oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du wī ṇi'i gnas su/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ hā sya/ lā sya/ gī ti/ nṛ tyai/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ rnams dang*/ oṃ rū pa badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rū pa'i gnas su ra sa/ sparshe/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ drag byed chen po zhal brgyad mche gtsigs phyag bcu drug /ral pa gyen brdzes mun pa lta bu thod pas dbu brgyan pa// dbang phyug rus pa sbrul gyis brgyan cing hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug sgra sgrog /dor stabs bdud bzhi'i gdan la zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs// 'jigs byed bai ḍūr mdog can khyod la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rang 'od las sprul sgyu ma'i lha mo bdag med sngo sangs chags chen 'dul mkhas ma// dbu skra phyed bcings sil bu grol zhing yab la dang bas lhan cig 'khyud mkhas ma// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs 'gying tshul thod skam dbu brgyan do shal 'chang mkhas ma// dga' bzhi'i bdag mo khyod la gus bstod bde ba'i rang bzhin gsang gsum bdag med ma// ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo nyid 'dzin ma// gau rī la sogs phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi// 'byung bzhi dag cing tshad med bzhi mnga' ma// pukka sī sogs mtshams kyi lha mo ste// sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐

'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnam ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*| zhal nas thon gzung thag la brgyud de bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs brgyud bskul/ mkha' gsang nas bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang zhing rgyas par gyur/ par dmigs la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badzra nai rātmā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra gau rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsau rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra be tā lī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra pukka sī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sha wa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa li' huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍoṃ bhi nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'khor gyi snying po rnams ci rigs par bzlas/ slar yang las bum la dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs par bzlas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i chags pa'i sgras bskul la/ 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur pa ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ces dang*/ las bum gyi lhas ji srid sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par ma gyur gyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig / ces zhu'o// de nas mdun bskyed sgrub cing dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon du rung bar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la tshul bzhin du gnas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa/ dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi dbang mnos shing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ sa chog dang*/ thig gdab pa dang*/ tshon bkye ba sogs dbang gi chu bo mdzes rgyan las 'byung ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gzhung las/

mig ras me tog gu gul til// rigs drug mchod pa dbu rgyan dang*// rdor dril mig thur me long dang*// 'bud dung 'khor lo po ti dang*// mda' gzhu snam sbyar bdud rtsi sogs// nyer mkho thams cad tshogs bya'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor la mkho ba'i yo byad 'du bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa las 'byung ba ltar bshams la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur rgyal yongs su gyur pa las/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas sngon po gru gsum zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong ltar brjod la/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin brlabs la/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te/ dkyil 'khor la mchod par dmigs la/ mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho dpag med na// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te// bdag pos yongs su bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod yon rnam pa ji snyed yod pa kun// gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs la// tshogs gnyis bsag phyir gus pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin stsol// oṃ shrī he badzra sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dang mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan/ zhes dang*/ argha ཾ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad/ zhes sbyar la mchod/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ shrī he badzra sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na| |bzhes shing bla med dngos grub bstsal du gsol// shapad= phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dri chab ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gandhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems tshim byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa gang mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med dngos grub bstsal du gsol// sparshe= de nas rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'dod yon la gnas pa'i// yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tshos rab brgyan ma// 'jo sgeg rnam ldan rmad byung bde ster ma// sprul pa'i lha mo rin chen rgyan spras ma// sngon mo pi wang snyan par sgrog mdzad ma// ser mo yid 'ong gling bu sgyur mdzad ma// dmar mo rnga zlum rab tu bskul mdzad ma/ */ljang gu mdzes pa'i rdza rnga brdung mdzad ma// dmar skya 'dzum zhing bzhad pa'i tshul mdzad ma// sngon mo sgeg cing 'gying ba'i nyams mdzad ma// ser mo snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len mdzad ma// ljang gu gar gyi rol rtsed sgyur mdzad ma// dkar mo sna tshogs me tog phreng 'dzin ma// sngon mo dri zhim bdug pa'i spos 'dzin ma// dmar mo 'od 'bar snang gsal mchog 'dzin ma// ljang gu dri bzang chu yi snod 'dzin ma// dkar mo dri med me long rab 'dzin ma| |dmar mo ro drug bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin ma// ljang gu srab 'jam rnam bkra'i gos 'dzin ma// dkar mo chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog 'dzin ma// dpag med sprul nas dkyil 'khor mchod par bgyi// oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

de bzhin du wī ṇi'i gnas su/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ hā sya/ lā sye/ gī ti/ nṛ tyai/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ rnams dang*/ oṃ rū pa badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rū pa'i gnas su/ ra sa/ sparshe/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces bcu drug gis mchod/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ bdud rtsi lag tu thogs la/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dri chen klad pa dang*// byang sems rakta dri chu bdud rtsi lnga// mi khyi ba glang rta yi sha la sogs// yongs su sbyangs shing sbyang spel bsgyur ba yi// rmad byung bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ḍā ki bdag med ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor nag po pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen ḍā ma ru pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a wa dhū ti pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ga ya dha ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'brog mi'i lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ se ston kun dga' rig gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhang ston chos 'bar gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal ārya'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhang dkon mchog dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje bsod nams shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan tshul khrims ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen buddha shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngor pa kun dga' ratna'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lcags lung pa chen po gzhon nu chos grub kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun kun dga' sgrol mchog gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje rdo ring pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badzra kartā ri he badzra oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnaṃ badzra nai rātmā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gau rī gaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ be tā lī baṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pukka sī paṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī laṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍoṃ bhi nī ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lā bi kā la rā tri ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ḍoṃ bi nī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tsaṇḍa lī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rakṣa sī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ siṅga lī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de wī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyad par du dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong lha klu gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gzhi bdag 'gro drug gi sems can dpal dgyes pa rdo rje dang tsa turmu kha'i lhar gyur pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ yab kyi gsang ba'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas/ bde ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pas mchog tu dga' ba/ snying kha nas lte bar sleb pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtser sleb pas lhan cig nyams su myong zhing*/ lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas chags pa med pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// tha dad mi dmigs grub pa med// de phyir mchod pa chen po ste// skye gnas 'gro 'ong bral ba'i phyir// bla med mchod pa mchog gis mchod// ces mchod do// de nas bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin la 'di skad do// hūm̐ chos dbyings mi 'gyur bde chen he ru kaḥ

/sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdog lta bu// rnam thar brgyad kyi phyogs mtshams zhal brgyad gzigs// stong pa bcu drug phyag gis rab tu spras// tshad med bzhi mtshon zhabs bzhi dor stabs bsgrad// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu yi rgyan du mdzes// rnam rtog yongs dag rus pa'i rgyan drug spras// zhe sdang rtsad gcod stag gi pags pa grol// bdud bzhi 'jig byed mche gtsigs rngam pa'i zhal// rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod rdo rjes mtshan// chags pa spang phyir bdag med ma dang sbyor// nyon mongs 'dam skem nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs// thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid// chos dbyings ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// nges pa lnga ldan zhing 'dir khyod sprul pa// dgyes pa rdo rje yum la phyag 'tshal lo// gau rī lha mo me long ye shes dang*// mnyam nyid ye shes lha mo tsau rī ma// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes be tā lī// ghasma rī ni bya grub ye shes nyid// phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa tshad med lha mo pukka sī// snying rje tshad med lha mo sha wa rī// dga' ba tshad med lha mo gdol pa mo// btang snyoms tshad med lha mo g.yung mo ste// mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// sku lnga yongs rdzogs rtsig pa kha dog lnga// 'dod snam dra phyed pha gu mda' yab dang*// bcu gcig grangs nges rta babs rdo rje'i rwa| |padma chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs kyis brgyan// sna tshogs padma rdo rje'i ra bas bskor// yul snang tshogs brgyad dag phyir dur khrod brgyad// nyon mongs bsreg phyir ye shes me ri 'bar| |de lta'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// lha mchog khyed dang smon lam gcig gi mthus// 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// lha mchog khyod dang mi 'bral 'grogs pa dang*// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchog thun dngos grub stsol// he ru ka yi go 'phang myur thob shog

/ ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur/ ces dmigs te/ aṣṭa ni/ oṃ aṣṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lordhā ke sha warda mā ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti nai trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dha ri ṇe/ adhmā ta krūr tsittā ya/ ardhendu daṃ ṣḍī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga rā ṇa/ bhandha bhandha/ nā gāṣṭa kān/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sha trūṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ hāḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rtsa sngags so// oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ badzra kartā ri he badzra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ āḥnaṃ badzra nairātmā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum kyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ āḥgaṃ badzra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ badzra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbaṃ badzra be tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ badzra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥpaṃ badzra pukka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ badzra sha wa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā| oṃ āḥḍaṃ badzra ḍoṃ bhi nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lha mo brgyad kyi snying po'o// oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lha mo brgyad kyi nye snying po'o// de ltar mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs bya'o// de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/

byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la/ oṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ aṣṭa na nā yaḥ zhes pa'i bar sngags lan gsum brjod la/ lha thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis bdud rtsi'i gtor ma gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces dang*/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo gar dang bcas pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor| |khyod ni de nyid thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid| |he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// zhes brjod/ de nas phyi rol phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ sgrub grogs la dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol phyin la/ gtor ma sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du pad zla'i gdan la so sor gsal ba/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong rnams dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ mdun du rang rang gi gdan so so la 'khod par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ ind+ra ye/ ya mā ye/ ku be ra/ ma hā bhū ta/ āgna ye/ rakṣa sa/ bā yu de wa ta/ tsand+ra/ sūrya/ brahma/ a de wa/ be ma tse tri/ pṛ thi wī de wa ta sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ paṇḍi ta sarba de wa ta/ sā dha ka sya shāntiṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru| sarba karayantu/ siddhibha wantu/ ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ zhes spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos kyang mchod la/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pas 'od zer gyi ljags sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ bhū ta/

pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs nang du log /de nas slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ bdag nyid 'jug pa'i don du blang ba ni/ dbang rdzas rnams gzhung ltar 'du byas la/ gtor chung ting lo changs bu rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ slob ma sta gon dgos na skabs 'dir bya/ de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus khrus bya/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon gyis ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang dag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*| |yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol| |dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ tsakṣurbahandha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog gtad la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dang*/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o// zhes dang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes 'dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go// zhes lan btab par mos la/ snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdam pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag / ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying ga dang spyi bor bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ */

zhes dang*// 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di khyod kyis su la yang smras na/ 'dis khyod kyis mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon dpal he ru ka kyai rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na ya nga ba ma spang bar 'chi ba'i dus byas te sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes dam la bzhag /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs las dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i lte bar hūm̐ gtum mo'i me dang*/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ ro rkyang rlung gis gtum mo'i me cher sbar bas/ spyi bo'i haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab/ lus thams cad brjod med kyi bde bas khyab pa dang*/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa dpal kyai'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar sib sib thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo dkrol/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sarba maṇḍa la ā we sha ya a a āḥ zhes mang du brjod/

tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la brtan par bya'o| |de'i tshe bar snang gi kha dog brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi nam mkha' la/ */khyod kyi mig la ji ltar snang*/ zhes dri/ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing khrar mthong*// zhes dang*/ deng nas bzung ste khyod rnams kyis// zhi dang rgyas pa'i las rnams dang*// dbang du bya dang dgug pa dang*// las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes brjod/ rigs kyi lha brtag pa'i me tog dor ba ni/ he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes dor/ me tog dbus su bab par mtshon te/ dga' ba'i rdo rje sogs gsang ming btags/ de nas mig thur thogs te/ mig dbye ba ni/ kyai rdo rje deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par bya// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te| |rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badzra pa shya hoḥ / zhes gdong g.yogs dkrol la/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi he ru kaḥ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// gsang sngags 'di la brtson par gyis// 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs dur khrod me ri dang bcas pa'i nang*/ dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu pa ni/ khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig / ces bstan to// de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// dngos gzhi thog mar sbyang ba ni/ gtor chung ting lo chab kyis bran te/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/

gtor chung rim pa ltar blangs la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sogs brjod cing*/ slar yang ting lo gsum rim gyis g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod cing dor/ de nas rang gi mdun du g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu/ dbus su ting lo bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab khung zlum po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsams la/ rang gi rkang zhabs kyi rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po gnas pa de me lces ded sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur/ sna nas thon/ mdun gyi til la thim/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhal gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdor dril dang ldan pas mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ g.yas kyis g.yas dang*/ g.yon gyis g.yon du bskor zhing*/ me dang chur dor ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal dang rgya mtshor dor bar bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ badzra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de dag sbyang ba'i rim pa'o// de nas rdo rje'i slob mas dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bdag dang dbang rdzas bum chu hūm̐ dang rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/

g.yas brgyad kyis rdo rje g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung ste dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des bum pa'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje'i sa bon bag chags ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag / ces brjod/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bdag dang dbang rdzas rigs lnga rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis rin po che dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma bdag med ma dang snyoms par sbyor ba/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas rigs lnga dang bum pa rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyi mchog gyur pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag / ces brjod/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bdag dang dbang rdzas padma dzrīṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas kyai rdo rje dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis padma dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas rdo rje dang bum pa bzung nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis zung*| |oṃ ma hā badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes dbang bskur/ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag / ces brjod/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bdag dang dbang rdzas ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje ljang khu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis ral gri dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang snyoms par sbyor ba rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs| de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lhas dril bu dang bum pa mnyam par bzung ste dbang bskur bar gyur/ dril bu shes rab nyid ldan pa'i| |'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam tshig mchog tu bsngags pa'i phyir// rab tu bsgrub phyir dril bu sbyin// oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag | ces brjod/ rang dang rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la 'khor lo bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang rdo rje dril bu rnams kyai rdo rje dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa/ g.yas brgyad kyis 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang snyoms par sbyor ba rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lhas bum pa dang rdor dril mnyam du bzung nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab bzhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje ming ldan pas// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro| |oṃ badzra satwa twaṃ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ kyai dpal zhes 'dri/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag /de ltar bum chu'i bya ba rjes su 'gro bas rig pa'i dbang lnga thob/ phung po lnga sbyangs/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ rigs lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag

/'thob bya'i 'bras bu bya spyod kyi rgyud mtha' dag nyan pa dang*/ 'chad pa/ sngags bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes don bshad/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ me tog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur che// mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su bzung*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa bla na med pa stsol// rdo rje slob dpon rgyal srid che// bdag pos dbang bskur bdag la stsol// ces gsum brjod/ rang nyid dbang stegs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces dmigs te/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni| |rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul rdo rje'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje g.yas su sbyin/ dril bu aḥlas byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad//

ces g.yon du sbyin/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// de ni phyag byar rab tu grags// mi shigs phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyod do// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang yum rdo rje snyems ma gnyis tsumba na'i sbyor bas/ bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye bar gyur/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi lhas rdor dril dang bum chu bsnams nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rje byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs ni bsdu bar gyis// oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ 'di de phyi rol yul snang kun// dag phyir gzhal yas khang du shar// mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs// sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad steng*// sprul pa'i lha dgu yab dang bcas// so sor bzhugs kyang don gyis ni// rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi nang*// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// kun gyi ngo bo he ru kaḥ |de ltar chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur pa la/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ */gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la|

|sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// de ltar chos rnams thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar gyis shig /sems can gyi don gyis shig / ces brjod do// de nas rang nyid kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa/ yum bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i skur gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ ḍā ru/ rdor dril/ tshangs skud/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ gtad la/ kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed 'di// kyai yi rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /bdag med ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje dril bu mkha' 'gro brgyad// tshangs pa'i skud pa ka pā la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar bgyi// zhes sbyin/ de nas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ ces dang*/ sngags rnams lan gsum brjod la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas chos gos grwa gnyis dang bcas pa'i dril bu snying khar bzung la/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ 'di skad du/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par gyur/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung bstan par mdzad do// sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes brjod/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de nas mtha' rten gyi rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/

me long gtad la/ āḥlas byung ba'i me long 'di// rdo rje sems dpa'i me long ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes dang*/ mda' gzhu gtad la/ hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu 'di// chos nyid gzhu la ye shes mda'// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun la 'phen// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis// zhes dang*/ 'khor lo gtad la/ bhrūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di// oṃ badzra he tu māṃ// deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// bya ba spyod tshul gsang sngags kyi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes dang*/ dung gtad la/ āḥlas byung ba'i dung dkar 'di// oṃ badzra bhā ṣa raṃ// khyod kyis yid gnyis spangs byas te// chos kyi dung ni bla na med// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ */ zhes dang*/ po ti gtad la/ āḥlas byung ba'i po ti ni// gsang sngags kun la rtag tu bshad// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin kun khyod la srung*/ / zhes dang*/ dril bu gtad la/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu 'di/ */thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' stong pa nyid sbyor ba// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes brjod/ de dag gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang 'dogs bcas grub pas gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ / de nas/ gsang dbang gi maṇḍal phul nas| gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni de nyid thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// zhes gsum brjod/ mig dar bcings la/

slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sgras/ ha ha si si ku ru badzra ddhṛka/ ces pa'i sgras bskul te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ snying khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkha' gsang nas thon te/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs la/ bdud rtsi byin la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang bskur gyi// bu khyod de ltar dbang bskur ro| | zhes brjod cing*/ a hoḥm hā su kha/ zhes lce thog tu myang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mig dbye/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis bla ma yab yum gyi mkha' gsang la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam tsaṇḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par byas so// zhes don bshad/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid can// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsum brjod/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pas bdag med ma bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can rang la gtad cing*/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes gnang ba la/ lha mos/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i padmar 'o byed pa// bu khyod ji ltar dga' ba smros//

zhes dris ba la/ rang gis/ khu khrag la sogs za ba dang*// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i padmar 'o byed pa| |lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// zhes brjod la/ lha mos padma rgyas pa kha phyes nas bstan te/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun du bdag gnas so// gsang gnas bstan pa la sogs pa// padmar sbyar ba ji bzhin te// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spangs pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi pang du byung bar bsams te/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i yum dang sbyor ba mdzad pas| bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas lus thams cad khyab par gyur/ mtshan ldan bud med mthong ba dang*// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor byas te// thal sbyar nas ni gsol ba btab| |'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum la yang gzhan med do// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod ni nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam tshig bsgrags la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dbye/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bstsal du gsol// zhes gsum brjod gdong g.yog bcings la/ 'di ni dbang gsum pa'i dus su nyams su myong pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba brjod du med cing snang la rang bzhin med cing gsal la rdzogs pa/

dbang po'i tshon dang chu zla lta bu ste// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems de dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no| | zhes ngo sprad/ 'di ni rang rig mdzes ma ste// rig pa'i brtul zhugs ched gcig pu// rigs 'di bor nas de la ni// gzhan pa'i thabs kyi sangs rgyas med// khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// ma byin pa yang khyod kyis longs// thams cad la yang rdzun tshig smros// brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla med pa// mtshan med bsam gyis mi khyab pa// 'di la rtag tu gnas par gyis// zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dbye/ puṣpe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /lam bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi bsgom pa'i rim pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa ldan par byas so// zhes don bshad/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// zhes nas/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ de dag gis dbang gi rim pa legs par grub pa'o// de nas skabs 'dir lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// de nas tshogs rdzas sha chang la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod/ de nas lag pa g.yon gyi steng du tshom bu dgu bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ lag mthil padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar pad nyi'i gdan la/ kyai rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ mdun du gau rī ma/ g.yas su tsau rī ma/

rgyab tu bai tā lī/ g.yon du ghasma rī/ byang shar pukka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo rnams gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ he ru ka dpal bdag med ma// sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor// kun nas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// sha lnga bdud rtsi khu khrag dang*// bshang gci go ro tsa na sogs| |ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces dbyangs gsal brjod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs/ oṃ/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ma med// thog ma tha ma med pa'i phyir// sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// kyai rdo rje bdag 'grub mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod/ lag par gnas pa'i lha tshogs rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogs drangs shing*/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// nas/ rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// sogs brjod/ mched lcam rnams kyis/ 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba// rin thang med pa legs 'ong chos// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// ji bzhin bskyed par bdag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing bza' bar bya'o// de nas mched lcam rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ 'di skad do// kye hoḥtshogs su cang te'u 'khrol// snying rje'i ku co mi bya'o// de ni sha ru bza' bar bya// 'bad pas chang ni btung bar bya/ kye hoḥskal ldan 'jug par bya// skal med rnams ni spang ba bya| |ga pur rnams ni spang bar bya// tshod ma dang ni sha chen po// de ni mang du bza' bar bya// 'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar bya// dag dang ma dag mi dmigs bya// rus pa'i rgyan ni lus la gdags// der ni rum du gzhug par bya// 'du bar 'khrig la 'jug pa bya// der ni rig min spang bar bya// dgag sgrub bral slad ma bcos pa// lam 'di 'grub phyir a la la//

zhes brjod/ lhag ma bsdus la rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha chus bran/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi utstshiṣṭa ba lingta bhakṣa bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo dang bcas gtsang sar bskyal lo// de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ he ru ka dpal dbang phyug btsun mor bcas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes pa'i phyir// gzung 'dzin bral ba'i mchod yon 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la bde ba'i mchog stsol mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ sgra snyan/ zhes bsgyur/ arghaṃ sogs kyi mal du/ pā dyaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad/ zhes sbyar la mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bde stong dbyer med khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ /mche gtsigs drag byed bai ḍūrya lta bu// dga' bzhi'i bdag med yum dang gnyis med sbyor// nyid sprul lha mo brgyad dang gzhal yas khang*// srung 'khor 'od phreng pad rdor me rir bcas// rten dang brten par bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag sgrub pa'i mched lcam 'khor bcas kyi// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba dang*// lhag pa'i lha mchog khyod kyi thugs rje yis// gsang sngags zab mo'i chos sgor 'jug pa dang*// nyan dang 'chad dang 'bri sogs legs mnos shing*// dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchog /bdag sogs kun gyis gegs med 'grub par shog /

ces bstod/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// ma mnyes yongs su ma mchis pa// rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis ni// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa kun// de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod// ces brjod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la lhag chad kha bskangs/ oṃ/ he ru ka dpal bdag med yum dang bcas// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro brgyad la brten bcas dang*// lha tshogs srung 'khor chos kyi dbyings su gshegs// khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs| dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ bkra shis gang zhig kyai rdo rje 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab bdag med yum gyi padmar rdo rje shin tu rol mdzad pa// bde chen gnyis med 'khor lo mchog de dga' ba bzhi yi dbang phyug gtso// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog |gang zhig ye shes bzhi yi rang gzugs rab 'chang zhing*// tshad med bzhi yis 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol mdzad pa// gau rī la sogs lha mo brgyad du shar ba 'di// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /phyi rol yul snang rab tu dag pa'i phyir// gzhal yas pad rdor rdo ra me ri dur khrod ri// rang lus rtsa khams dpa' bo dpa' mo'i ngang*// bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag shar// bum thod rdor dril kha ṭwāṃ ga la sogs// yo byad so so'i rnam par shis des kyang*| |bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /nam mkha' skye ba mtshan med phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i phyir// sems dpa' rdo rje che'i rang bzhin// kyai rdo rje bdag 'grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag 'grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dga' ba kun gyi mchog

/gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems dga' bdag grub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// gdod nas mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor gyis// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis kun bdag la// khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs shig /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// nas/ de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog / ces dang*/ bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs brjod/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin na/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes shar sgo nas rim gyis bsdus te bum par blugs nas/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam/ klu gnas nges pa'i chu mig tu gshegs su gsol/ thig la sogs pa rjes kyi las mi mngon par bya'o// gzhan yang 'di'i sa chog dang*/ bum pa/ slob ma rnams kyi sta gon dang*/ thig dang*/ tshon bkye ba sogs mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bya zhing*/ zhib par dbang gi chu bo mdzes rgyan du rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ gsang sngags chos tshul rin chen gling 'dra'i gnas// rin chen 'dod phyir ded dpon rnam dpyod mkhan// blo gros ldan pas gling der bsgrod pa la// dgos 'dod dbang rgyal lta bu'i chos gcig po// gnyis med rgyud don kyai rdo rje yi// sgrub thabs don bsdus gsal bar bkod 'di mtshar// gang zhig khungs med rang bzo mkhan srid na// kla klo rnams la'ang mkhas pa cis mi 'byung*// de phyir bka' la brten cing lung gis grub// rig pas bsgrub phyir nyams su myong ba la// gtam rgyud kun mthun tshad ma bzhi ldan mdzod// dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal srid dbang bsgyur lung rtogs mnga' bdag sa skya pa// de las legs 'ongs rgyud rgyal kun gyi snying po mchog gyur he badzra// sgrub thabs chog bsgrigs gsal bar bkod pa'i rnam dkar dge ba gang mchis des// 'gro rnams bde stong thabs shes zung 'jug kyai rdo rje myur thob shog

/ces sgrub thabs dang dbang gi rim pa 'di'ang*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa la gzhi byas/ legs par sbyar ba'i mkhan po gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i chos tshul ji snyed pa'i dbus su bde bar gnas te/ gzu bor 'doms pa'i rnam dpyod kyi zlos gar phyogs kun tu bsgyur ba lha 'di nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dharma kīrtis shing stag gi dbyar zla ra ba'i nyer bzhi nyin ma dros chu klung chen po'i 'gram du legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ//
